stem_md: 函数 $f(x,y)=e^{-x}\sin(x+2y)$ 在 $(0,\pi/4)$ 沿 $y$ 轴正向的方向导数是。
analysis_md:
$$\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}\right|_{\left(0,\frac{\pi}{4}\right)}=-e^{-x}\sin(x+2y)+e^{-x}\cos(x+2y)\bigg|_{\left(0,\frac{\pi}{4}\right)}=-1,$$

$$\left.\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}\right|_{\left(0,\frac{\pi}{4}\right)}=2e^{-x}\cos(x+2y)\bigg|_{\left(0,\frac{\pi}{4}\right)}=0,$$ 沿 $y$ 轴负方向的转角为 $\frac{3\pi}{2}$，则方向导数为：

$$\left.\frac{\partial f}{\partial l}\right|_{\left(0,\frac{\pi}{4}\right)}=(-1)\cos\frac{3\pi}{2}+0\sin\frac{3\pi}{2}=0.$$
